name: netdisco-frontend
description: Manifest for the vendored frontend libraries in share/public. Not a build step: this exists so dependency scanners can see what is shipped. jquery-ui 1.10.3, toastr 1.1.1 and qtip2 2.0.1 are vendored too, but none of those versions was ever published to npm, so they cannot be declared here; each gets an entry when it is upgraded to a version that was.
